# The Toro Company OneFleet™ Program Offers Savings Across Its Leading Brand Portfolio


### Qualifying fleet customers can access exclusive savings across participating brands within The Toro Company portfolio, including Toro compact equipment.


Oct 21, 2026 |[Construction](https://newsroom.toro.com/en/construction) |[Professional Contractor](https://newsroom.toro.com/en/professional-contractor) |[Rental](https://newsroom.toro.com/en/rental) |[Homeowner](https://newsroom.toro.com/en/homeowner)


-
-
-


To help lawn maintenance professionals, landscape contractors and other professional customers expand their capabilities across applications and seasons, The Toro Company has launched[OneFleet](https://info.toro.com/onefleet) , which gives qualifying fleet customers access to exclusive promotional savings across participating brands. By connecting fleet customers with additional equipment solutions across The Toro Company portfolio, OneFleet provides more ways to meet the evolving needs of customers, take on new types of work and maximize savings.


Under the OneFleet program, qualifying U.S. fleet customers can build on their relationship with The Toro Company to access up to 21% in exclusive fleet savings across participating brands and product categories, spanning compact construction, mowing and turf care, snow and ice management, irrigation, landscape lighting and more.


“With the OneFleet program, we are breaking down barriers and introducing new ways to deliver real, bottom-line value for our customers,” says Tom Werner, general manager for Toro Sitework Systems. “Toro’s lineup of compact equipment is built to help contractors tackle a wide range of applications. By pairing equipment such as Dingo® compact utility loaders and Ultra Buggy® material buggies with other essentials from The Toro Company, such as snowplows, lawn maintenance equipment, irrigation and lighting solutions, contractors have more options to outfit their fleets for year-round work while taking advantage of exclusive savings.”


The OneFleet program expands access to brands and product categories across The Toro Company portfolio with exclusive offers for qualifying fleet customers:


- **Toro Compact Construction Equipment:** Dingo compact utility loaders and attachments, Ultra Buggy material buggies, stump grinders and trenchers designed for durability and productivity.


- **BOSS Snowplow:** Professional-grade snowplows, material spreaders and liquid de-icing systems designed to perform in harsh winter conditions.


- **Toro Mowing and Turf Equipment:** Commercial zero-turns, stand-on mowers and professional landscape maintenance machinery.


- **Toro Residential & Commercial Irrigation:** Advanced water-management systems, controllers and efficiency-driven irrigation solutions.


- **Ventrac:** Multi-attachment tractors equipped for all-season slope and site management.


- **Exmark:** Durable commercial zero-turn lawn mowers and turf equipment.


- **Z Turf Equipment:** High-efficiency lawn care application equipment, including spreaders and sprayers.


- **Unique Lighting Systems:** Premium low-voltage landscape lighting solutions for full site transformation.


Customers qualify for OneFleet through an existing, active fleet relationship with participating brands within The Toro Company portfolio. Qualifying customers retain their existing brand-specific fleet benefits while gaining access to additional promotional offers from other participating brands. OneFleet is an added benefit and does not replace existing brand fleet programs.


“Our customers’ needs extend well beyond a single equipment category, and we want to support them wherever their business takes them,” says Werner. “OneFleet is our way of rewarding customer loyalty by giving contractors more ways to gear up across leading brands and products from The Toro Company.”


To learn more about the OneFleet program and view participating brands, current offers and dealer locations, visit[info.toro.com/OneFleet](https://info.toro.com/onefleet) .


Megan Monsour | Rental & Construction | |megan.monsour@toro.com


##### About Toro


With roots dating back to 1914, Toro is a leading worldwide provider of innovative solutions for the outdoor environment including turf and landscape maintenance, snow management, rental and construction equipment, and irrigation solutions. Through a strong network of distributors, dealers, retailers and rental stores in more than 125 countries, Toro helps customers care for golf courses, sports fields, public green spaces, commercial and residential properties, construction sites and agricultural operations.
